queries.result: Search found an official Xinjiang Natural Resources article documenting the Changji prefecture unified real-estate registration platform, including Changji City coverage and a GIS-based map-attribute-file system. registryBasis: Official Xinjiang Natural Resources reporting states that the Changji prefecture unified real-estate registration platform integrates all county/city systems, covers Changji City, and maintains GIS spatial information in a map-attribute-file system. The Changji government site independently identifies the Changji City Natural Resources Bureau as an enforcement/land custodian.

source.name: Changji prefecture unified real-estate registration platform
source.operator: 昌吉州自然资源局 / 昌吉市自然资源局
source.serviceType: Official local/county-city registry platform with GIS spatial data; anonymous parcel geometry not verified.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Official report says the unified platform integrates all county/city registration systems in Changji prefecture and includes GIS spatial information for multiple real-estate classes.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: The official report establishes platform existence and Changji City coverage, but no public viewer/API, schema, CRS, or anonymous ID-plus-geometry response was verified.

technicalBlocker: Official first-party pages describe the platform but do not publish a usable public map-service URL or machine-readable parcel endpoint. The Changji government homepage was fetched successfully; no anonymous parcel service link or current JavaScript/configuration exposing safe geometry was found. A stale/incorrect direct article URL attempt returned HTTP 404 and was not treated as evidence of absence.
remainingUncertainty: The official platform may expose parcel geometry through an authenticated, browser-mediated, or non-indexed service. No exact-point hit or citywide absence inference is made, and the WUP point was not shifted.
nextStep: Hold runtime integration. A later researcher may qualify a public first-party parcel endpoint only after independently verifying current JavaScript/configuration, schema, CRS, stable native identity, and safe ID-plus-geometry output.
pointBasis: Exact immutable WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement point; not shifted to force a parcel hit.
